evals.prompt: Read the git diff at evals/files/auth-token-validator.diff and generate a Conventional Commits message for it. Output only the message — no preamble, no markdown.
evals.expected_output: Example: 'feat(auth): add length validation for JWT tokens'.

Description mentions length validation or token length
